description: Weekly PRs (against development) for every version pinned outside ArgoCD: k3s, the Helm charts / Istio / images Ansible deploys, host tools, Terraform, the CI Python tools. Each pin carries a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment on the line above it. ArgoCD apps are updated by Image Updater; GitHub Actions, the alert-forwarder Dockerfile and npm by Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml). No pull_request CI: merge into development, then promote as usual.

packageRules.description: Release tags are vX.Y.Z, the pins are X.Y.Z
k3s server + agents + the runners' kubectl move together, one minor version at a time (Kubernetes only supports +1 minor upgrades)
Cluster add-ons Ansible installs (Helm charts, Istio, Gateway API CRDs, helm-diff) — minor/patch in one PR; majors get their own
Images of Ansible-managed workloads (Alloy, cloudflared, Tempo, node-exporter, kube-state-metrics, GPU plugin, ca-cert nginx) — minor/patch in one PR
Host tools: AdGuard, Actions runner, Proxmox exporters, Terraform, CI Python tools
Majors (and Terraform, whose state format moves with it) never group: each is its own reviewed PR
